decisions.summary: Keep product repositories independent and build a portfolio-level control plane rather than a source-code monolith.
Use exact repository HEAD SHAs as the first cache key and inspect unchanged repositories only when the task specifically requires deeper evidence.
Reserve PRJ-000 for Portfolio Brain and keep stable project identities separate from repository identities.
Use four autonomy classes (OBSERVE, EXPERIMENT, MODIFY, ACT) with deny-by-default semantics and the most restrictive applicable rule winning.
No project receives unbounded external ACT authority; consequential external actions remain human-gated and market-surveillance live trading/execution remains prohibited.
Treat existing GitHub workflow write/deploy credentials as capabilities of those workflows, not as blanket authority for Portfolio Brain.
Use changed-path/risk-aware targeted test selection rather than running every downstream repository test suite after every candidate change.
Treat dependency manifests and lockfiles as promotion evidence; manifest/lockfile changes should trigger dependency-specific validation rather than relying on one successful install.
Use ARCHITECTURE_EVIDENCE_BUNDLE.json plus the current SHA delta as the canonical prework handoff into Portfolio Brain Step 0; do not rescan unchanged repositories by default.

At architecture handoff, re-inspect only the two repositories whose HEADs diverged from the pinned snapshot (github-value-hunt-ledger and abvmschoolstarworld) before completing master Step 0; keep the other five repositories cached unless a specific architecture question requires them.
Reuse canonical ai_business_os and existing TI controls through pinned interfaces; business_os remains frozen legacy.
Reuse the command center, portfolio planner and production read bridge; require separated observation credentials and authenticated human authority before runtime integration.
Treat scouts as pre-verification intake; connect findings through existing immutable run/claim/lease/verifier/outcome paths rather than create a competing Hunter control plane.
Preserve prework inventories byte-for-byte and append delta evidence; distinguish discovered tests from currently invoked CI tests.
GitHub stores code, policy and sanitized evidence receipts; private operating/customer payloads stay in authorized private storage.
Minimum budgets, timeouts, retry bounds, idempotency and kill switches are prerequisites for recurring execution before the full Step 20 governor.

Root PORTFOLIO_BUILD_STATE.json is now canonical for master steps 0–25; portfolio_prework/PORTFOLIO_BUILD_STATE.json is immutable completed prework history. current_step denotes the next pending step. Artifact commit_sha records the creation checkpoint; the containing state commit is resolved from the isolated branch HEAD to avoid a self-referential Git hash.
Record ABVM runtime and test coverage changes explicitly; green narrowed CI is not proof of inherited offline/calendar/persistence coverage.

Stage Step 1 foundation artifacts on an isolated Hunter infrastructure branch until the dedicated PRJ-000 repository can be created; this staging branch grants no downstream authority and will not be treated as the final Portfolio Brain repository.

Represent the uncreated dedicated repository with a relocatable portfolio_brain_seed manifest. The Step 1 registration mechanism is deny-by-default and grants no authority; Step 2 will expand it into the full project/autonomy/objective/metric schemas.

blockers.summary: permitplate-state is currently public while durable architecture treats it as sensitive operational state; review intended visibility and access controls before integrating it into Portfolio Brain.

Production reuse requires live identity, privilege, deployment and independent-verifier evidence. Existing gateway token includes write operations; observers must not inherit it. Blocks integration/activation, not architecture completion.
ABVM active CI excludes retained browser suites and unit invocation; record current coverage/persistence/calendar limitations before future reliance.

The connected GitHub API exposes no repository-creation action. A browser writer exists but has multiple indistinguishable account links and cannot be selected safely without owner input. Step 1 artifacts may be staged here, but the dedicated P00NSMASHER/portfolio-brain repository still must be created before Step 1 can complete.
